defects: Specializes the ring to ℤ instead of quantifying over an arbitrary topological commutative ring R as in the gold (drops the generality/hypotheses `(R : Type*) [CommRing R] [TopologicalSpace R]`)

Uses `∏' n, ...` (tprod, a junk-valued totalized operator that defaults to 1 when no product exists) instead of `HasProd`, so the statement does not directly assert unconditional convergence of the product to the given series the way the gold does

Correspondingly uses `∑' k, ...` (tsum) for the right-hand side instead of a named/definitionally-fixed series like `pentagonalSeries R`, relying on convergence of the tsum rather than an explicit series object

No explicit `TopologicalSpace` hypothesis/instance is introduced for `PowerSeries ℤ`, unlike the gold which explicitly carries `[TopologicalSpace R]`; without a suitable Hausdorff/pi-topology instance in scope the tprod/tsum equality may not even be well-typed or may not correctly capture convergence
